attempts.refined_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?riskTolerance ?totalDeposit ?totalRebalance
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?riskTolerance (SUM(xsd:decimal(?depAmt)) AS ?totalDeposit)
    WHERE {
      ?cf a wm:CashFlow .
      ?cf wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?inv .
      ?cf wm:amount ?depAmt .
      ?inv wm:riskTolerance ?riskTolerance .
      ?cf wm:hasCashFlowType ?cft .
      ?cft rdfs:label ?cftLabel .
      FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?cftLabel)), "deposit"))
    }
    GROUP BY ?riskTolerance
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    SELECT ?riskTolerance (SUM(xsd:decimal(?rebAmt)) AS ?totalRebalance)
    WHERE {
      ?ra a wm:RebalancingAction .
      ?ra wm:rebalancingActionOfInvestor ?inv2 .
      ?ra wm:amount ?rebAmt .
      ?inv2 wm:riskTolerance ?riskTolerance .
    }
    GROUP BY ?riskTolerance
  }
}
ORDER BY ?riskTolerance
